principles: Choose an exact visual moment, not a static adjective bundle.
Every visible hand needs a physically traceable job or relaxed resting state.
Body weight/support must agree with pose and environment.
Fabric and loose materials react to movement, gravity, wind/water and artifact medium.
Light must come from motivated scene sources and produce medium-specific response.
Foreground/midground/background should carry narrative information without clutter.
The micro-story should be visible through attention/action/relationship, not written exposition.
anti_pattern: beautiful subject + location + cinematic + masterpiece + 8K without causal visual direction
